## Proposal: Move H-1B Registration Intake Deadline to January 15

*For Thursday's discussion — Marcus (and Rosa for the tracker piece)*

I'd like to move our internal intake deadline for H-1B registrations from an open-ended February trickle to a firm date of January 15. My instinct is that we frame this as better service rather than a tighter deadline on clients — most of the crunch last season was our process, not client delay, because we never gave anyone a date to work against.

Last season we filed 14 registrations for 6 employer clients, and 9 of the 14 came in during the final week of February. Rosa logged roughly 11 hours of overtime in the week the window opened. Right now intake works like this: we email the questionnaire whenever an employer asks, so the work arrives unpredictably and piles up at the end. A set date gives us something to plan against.

That unpredictability is also where our risk lives. Brightwater Analytics sent a beneficiary's passport scan two days before the window opened; the passport had expired in October, and we only caught it because Rosa checked the dates. The registration itself is simple, but errors are expensive — a wrong passport means an invalid selection. An earlier intake date buys us time to catch problems before they cost a client a seat.

On timing: January 15 is realistic. HR teams are back from holidays with Q1 budgets set, and the $215 per-beneficiary fee is already built into employers' Q1 numbers. One HR contact told me she would have happily sent everything in January if we'd asked.

**What would actually change**

- Engagement letters and a one-page questionnaire go out the week of December 7.
- Intake closes January 15; anything later is handled case by case.
- Rosa owns the tracker and gets a clean six weeks to chase gaps.
- Fee handling stays as it is today.

If we're aligned on Thursday, we can get the December letters out that week and spend the holidays with intake closed.

reasons: The closing line says they'd 'spend the holidays with intake closed', but intake stays open until January 15, after the December holidays.
